snippet.title: Hyperdrive Inn - Console Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Out this July 31th on PS5 and Xbox!
https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10019897
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/hyperdrive-inn/9n4zsb605689
Hyperdrive Inn is a point & click adventure where you embark on a journey across an infinite hotel, making every playthrough featuring a different set of challenges and puzzles as you are trying to find your father. Graphics made entirely out of scanned fabrics, fully original folk-inspired score & oddball humor.
Made by Horsefly games.
